TD.rules: Outdoors in open daylight conditions: the sun, sky and clouds are the only light sources, the sun's height and colour exactly as stated for the time of day.
TD.negatives: No lamps, no flash, no reflectors, no lens flare unless stated, no sun disc in frame unless stated.

SN.rules: Daylight shaped by the stated space (window, canopy, shade, opening); the space is shown only as much as needed to explain the light, and the light shape (patch, stripes, dapples) falls on the mannequin and the floor.
SN.negatives: No lamps or artificial light, no people, no furniture in front of the mannequin, no view through windows that shows recognisable places.

AR.rules: The light comes from the stated practical source, which is visible in frame when stated; its colour temperature and fall-off are physically correct.
AR.negatives: No readable signs or screens, no brand marks on lamps, no people, no extra light sources beyond those stated.

name.ja: ライティング位置（スタジオ）

PO.rules: A studio portrait lighting position on a plaster head-and-shoulders cast on a plinth, in front of the stated seamless backdrop; the only light is the stated rig, all lights, stands and modifiers out of frame; the position is stated relative to the front camera and must read on the face planes and the sphere.
PO.negatives: No visible lights, stands, cables or modifiers, no coloured light unless stated, no props.
PO.subject: bust

FX.rules: A stylised but physically plausible lighting effect as stated (coloured gels, haze, projected patterns), on a seamless dark grey studio set unless stated.
FX.negatives: No visible lamps unless stated, no strobing multiple exposures, no text projected, no glowing magic effects, no people.
